integrity: All sign certificates for dimensions 2–11 are exactly rational and replayable using the embedded standard-library checker. Root decimals are noncertifying illustrations; no independent review or worldwide priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Only quartic eggs and the complete finite range of complex dimensions 2 through 11 are classified; n>=12 and other exponents are not addressed. Off-diagonal Fefferman–Szegő kernel zeros only. The motivating 2026 work already contains the general kernel generating formula.
title: First Fefferman–Szegő zero transition for quartic eggs in complex dimension \(11\)
